title: Awesome product.
text: Awesome product.. I wanted this especially for pancake syrup..and to pour my pancake batter in to the pan easier. Works great . Very easy to fill the wide mouth jars then put the lid on. Can be used for so many things.

product_metadata.title: Soligt 4 Pack Mason Jar Lids, Wide Mouth Pour Spout Flip Cap Lids for Ball Brand Mason Jars, Leak Proof Airtight for Drinking Salad Dressing & Food Storing
features: Value Pack for Mason Jar Enthusiast: Includes 4 pack plastic mason jar lids (2 blue 2 red), Soligt versatile lid can turn your mason jar into a water bottle for drinking and pouring, storing a variety of liquids and foods, such as salad dress, syrup, ice tea, and nuts. (Perfectly match Ball-brand wide-mouth jars, not included in the package)
Upgraded Silicone Gasket: Soligt has greatly improved the material and sealing structure of the inserted silicone ring, for a airtight, leakproof seal that prevents spills and leaks.
Durable & BPA Free Material: Our exclusively-designed wide mouth mason jar lids are made of strong and reusable premium plastic, easy hand wash and dishwasher clean, and absolutely refrigerator safe.

User-Friendly Design: The convenient design embody most vividly, such as stepless adjustable flip cap making the cap never flip down freely when drinking from the jar/ and smooth spout for easy drink & pour/ groove surface for easy opening/ leak-proof snap-shut closure/ solid & comfortable handle.

Refund Guarantee: Soligt will promise full refund if you think the mason jar pour spout lids can not meet your satisfaction. (NOTE: This is for wide mouth mason jars, not for regular mouth. Please use it with Ball-brand jars instead of others.)
